top_choice_rationale: P002 (Buchwald and Hartwig) is the most mature and most cleanly attributed achievement on the slate: a general, ligand-controlled catalytic C-N coupling, mechanistically understood, independently reproduced for about three decades, with two independent groups and a two-name citation that excludes no one with a comparable claim. It is not a substrate extension of the 2010 prize, since amido-palladium chemistry and C-N reductive elimination needed new ligand design. P001 is the more novel mode of action and ranks second, but its credit (Ciulli, Sakamoto and others left out, two lineages in one citation) and clinical maturity are still open. P003 is mature but follows several biomolecular-tool prizes. A prize in some form is better than none.
